items.title: LimX unveils Luna humanoid robot for dance, work and live interaction
items.titleCn: LimX unveils Luna humanoid robot for dance, work and live interaction
items.summary: LimX launched Luna, a 160cm humanoid robot with 27 degrees of freedom, AI motion, and multimodal control, priced at $41,000.

items.title: China: ENGINEAI’s 129,000 sq ft factory claims to build one humanoid robot every 15 mins
